newsitem.title: USA: Hutchison Whampoa unit sets $2.0 bln debt.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison Whampoa unit sets $2.0 bln debt.

text.p: The following $2.0 billion four-tranche debt issue from Hutchison Whampoa Finance Ltd, a unit of Hutchison Whampoa Ltd, was priced on Thursday via joint lead mangers Goldman Sachs & Co Inc and Merrill Lynch & Co Inc.
BORROWER HUTCHISON WHAMPOA FINANCE LTD
AMT $750 MLN COUPON 06.95 MATURITY 08/01/07
TYPE BONDS ISS PRICE 99.801 FIRST PAY DATE 02/01/98
LAST MOODY'S A3 YIELD 06.978 PAY FREQ SEMI
LAST S&P A-PLUS SPREAD +82 BP CALLABLE NO
SECOND TRANCHE: AMT $500 MLN COUPON 07.45 MATURITY 08/01/17
TYPE BONDS ISS PRICE 99.897 FIRST PAY DATE 02/01/98
LAST MOODY'S A3 YIELD 07.46 PAY FREQ SEMI
LAST S&P A-PLUS SPREAD +99 BPS CALLABLE NO
THIRD TRANCHE: AMT $500 MLN COUPON 0.750 MATURITY 08/01/27
TYPE BONDS ISS PRICE 99.292 FIRST PAY DATE 02/01/98
LAST MOODY'S A3 YIELD 0.756 PAY FREQ SEMI
LAST S&P A-PLUS SPREAD +109 CALLABLE NO
FOURTH TANCHE: AMT $250 MLN COUPON 06.988 MATURITY 08/01/37
TYPE BONDS ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 02/01/98
LAST MOODY'S A3 YIELD 06.988 PAY FREQ SEMI
LAST S&P A-PLUS SPREAD +83 BPS *PUTABLE IN THE 12TH YEAR
NOTE: All tranches were part of a global/euro 144a debt offering.
